svg.aria-label: CalorAI system architecture and data flow
svg.title: CalorAI — system architecture and animated data flow

g.text: StateGraph · AgentState carries user_id · conditional edge on image · tool loop capped at 4 · history rehydrated from SQLite
zero cost on the common path
vision writes a [VISION] note — it never acts
macros resolve through the same table either way
a caption applies inside the same log_meal call
photographed meal and typed meal → identical numbers · never log-then-correct
Prompt assembly, then the model call
four local sources, all sub-millisecond SQLite reads — no model call to build the prompt
static instructions + worked examples · today's date · tier-1 memory (≤15 facts) · today's totals, pre-loaded
totals pre-loaded → "how am I doing?" costs zero tool calls
TOOL SURFACE · SPLIT BY SIDE EFFECT, NOT BY TOPIC — 10 TOOLS
one meal row, N item rows
quantity kept as its own column
→ the only tool that creates a meal
soft delete, filtered by every read
"same as yesterday" is a SQL query
→ user_id from contextvar, never an arg
exact match on the normalised name
LLM estimate — written back to the table
→ steps 1–3 cover almost every message · no network call on the hot path
RESOLUTION · MEMORY — THREE KINDS, DELIBERATELY SEPARATE
Names in the prompt, bodies in the database
aliases — tier 2, names only up front
the meals table — a SQL query
→ 40 saved shortcuts cost the same prompt tokens as 2 · upsert on (user_id, key)
async extractor · after the reply ships
SQLITE · THE INVARIANT EVERYTHING ELSE FOLLOWS FROM
Daily totals are never stored — always SUM(quantity × kcal_per_unit) at read time
6 tables · meals · meal_items · foods · memories · memory_history · messages — a correction is one UPDATE; there is no counter to drift
auth · 400 · permission → raise loudly, never mask a config bug
tools bind per provider before composing · stream only fails over pre-first-token
